message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023** (i.e., holidays that fall on a Friday or a Monday, or that are observed on a Monday when the statutory date falls on a weekend).  
If you’re building a holiday‑planning app, you can use this table directly or pull the same data from a public‑holiday API such as `https://date.nager.at/api/v2/publicholidays/2023/CA`.

| Date (2023) | Holiday | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Span | Notes |
|-------------|---------|-------------|-------------------|-------|
| **Feb 20** | Family Day (Ontario, BC, Alberta, Saskatchewan) | Monday | Sat Feb 18 – Mon Feb 20 | Creates a 3‑day weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon). |
| **Apr 7** | Good Friday | Friday | Fri Apr 7 – Sun Apr 9 | 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Sat‑Sun). |
| **May 24** | Victoria Day | Monday | Sat May 22 – Mon May 24 | 3‑day weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon). |
| **Jul 3** | Canada Day (observed) | Monday | Sat Jul 1 – Mon Jul 3 | Canada Day falls on Saturday; the observed day is Monday, creating a 3‑day weekend. |
| **Sep 4** | Labour Day | Monday | Sat Sep 2 – Mon Sep 4 | 3‑day weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon). |
| **Oct 9** | Thanksgiving | Monday | Sat Oct 7 – Mon Oct 9 | 3‑day weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon). |
| **Nov 13** | Remembrance Day (observed) | Monday | Sat Nov 11 – Mon Nov 13 | Remembrance Day falls on Saturday; the observed day is Monday, creating a 3‑day weekend. |
| **Dec 25** | Christmas Day | Monday | Sat Dec 23 – Mon Dec 25 | 3‑day weekend (Sat‑Sun‑Mon). |

### Quick API call (optional)

If you’d rather fetch the data programmatically, you can hit the Nager.Date public‑holiday API:

```bash
curl https://date.nager.at/api/v2/publicholidays/2023/CA
```

The JSON response will contain all statutory holidays, including the observed dates. You can then filter for holidays that fall on a Friday or Monday (or are observed on a Monday) to generate your own long‑weekend list.

---

Feel free to copy the table into your app’s database or use the API endpoint to keep the data up‑to‑date. Happy planning!
